mismatch_pattern_notes: The audit distinguishes rectangle quadrants, one-axis tolerance matches, and the boundary reports for nearest Pareto/joint candidates.
A coarse-grid or boundary-limited explanation is accepted only if the nearest Pareto boundary report indicates a plausible rectangle entry by expanding an existing neutral knob.

nearest_joint_candidate_boundary_report.assessment: Nearest candidates need many more parameters without the coupled FLOP increase, or many fewer FLOPs without reducing parameters; expanding existing neutral capacity knobs monotonically increases or preserves the mismatch under this accounting.

nearest_pareto_candidate_boundary_report.assessment: Nearest candidates need many more parameters without the coupled FLOP increase, or many fewer FLOPs without reducing parameters; expanding existing neutral capacity knobs monotonically increases or preserves the mismatch under this accounting.
